title: feat: record API changes and model replacements for news
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The news gist job now compares regenerated APIDOCS.md from post-deploy docs PRs to record added or removed endpoints and breaking parameter or body-field changes: removals, newly required fields, and narrowed types. It skips bodies documented on only one side and types shown as `any`, treating them as documentation gaps. The news index now has an `api` list alongside `models` and records model replacements through their alias (`model_id`, `previous_title`) as well as voice changes. The same code has backfilled the last 30 days on the news branch, including the `/models` status-filter change in #15059 and the voice-changer `audio` → `file` change in #16537.
